stages.name: Midday test pause
stages.what: Training is paused while 13 test jobs run (vision, the memory repair, servo strength, skin, falls); training restarts by itself after.

stages.name: Eye fixes: the second review's findings fixed
stages.what: The author fixes the seven findings of the second review of the eye-fix deploy code.

stages.name: Eye fixes: third review, its fixes, the merge
stages.what: An independent reviewer checks those fixes; the author fixes what it finds; the branch merges with its switches off.
after: Eye fixes: the second review's findings fixed
notes: merge early: the replay ring must record the controller's eye command for at least 6,000 steps on merged code before the F1 deploy stop, or the F1 verdicts are refused

stages.name: Production tests fixed
stages.what: An agent fixes the two tests that fail on production (the caregiver trial's stand-in learner, the takeover readers' item text); an independent reviewer checks it; it merges.
notes: the two test fixes merged at 87cb229e3; the closed test holes merged at c5bb62cba

stages.name: Test follow-ups: faults no test catches, tools that refuse production's settings
stages.what: A fresh agent adds the tests the second review proposed and makes two tools accept H84's settings.

stages.name: The self-percept runaway warning attributed
stages.what: H84's logs show the self-percept runaway warning 12,345 times from 3:50 to 5:51 PM (peak 30.5 against a limit of 8); an agent finds what runs away, since when, and what it does to learning.

stages.name: World restores carry every tracker; old lane worktrees inventoried
stages.what: A world restore drops eight per-frame trackers (the mobile's chime gate among them); an agent fixes it behind the migration rule. Another inventories five Sept 23 worktrees with uncommitted changes.

stages.name: Tools record the executed order as production does
stages.what: Twenty measurement tools (the review's count; eight found first) record the command they sent as the executed order, without the finger goal, the limb ledger or the calf projection production applies; one shared function fixes all eight; an independent reviewer checks it.

stages.name: Memory repair: review and fixes
stages.what: An independent reviewer checks the persistent-memory repair (reading this pause's measurements); the author fixes what it finds.
notes: the third fix round is on fix/persistent-memory-2026-09-25-v3 (worktree UEMA_memory_fix_v3)

stages.name: Memory repair measurement pause
stages.what: Training pauses while the fixed memory repair is measured on the graphics card (its bf16 fold and its cost).
notes: 5 of its 5 jobs never ran in an earlier pause, so each counts as 0 (persistent_memory_repair_v3_unit_tests, persistent_memory_repair_v3_card_proof, persistent_memory_repair_v3_measure, persistent_memory_repair_v3_attribution_switched, persistent_memory_repair_v3_switch_trial): this is the earliest it can end
the switch trial needs about 42 GB with nothing else heavy running: its own pause

stages.name: Balance-sense repair: review and fixes
stages.what: An independent reviewer checks the balance-sense repair; the author fixes what it finds.
notes: rehearsal (a CPU trainer run, 4 GB) goes in the next pause; the CPU and card measurements run in the pause the deploy resumes from, after the memory repair's watch

stages.name: Balance-sense measurement pause
stages.what: Training pauses while the balance-sense repair is measured on saved checkpoints.
notes: 4 of its 4 jobs never ran in an earlier pause, so each counts as 0 (vestibular_encoder_repair_unit_tests, vestibular_encoder_repair_measure, vestibular_encoder_repair_measure_card, vestibular_encoder_repair_rehearsal): this is the earliest it can end

stages.name: Servo strength: profile, review and fixes
stages.what: The servo agent commits the strength profile this pause picks; an independent reviewer checks it; the author fixes what it finds.

stages.name: Vision offset: next step
stages.what: The vision agent reads this pause's clipping and running-centre results, builds the next step they call for, and checks body 2's deaf vision.
notes: the results: clipping does not starve the head; the head's and gaze copy's own updates push the offset outward; the next step is a measurement (vision_regression.md sections 19-21)

stages.name: Vision measurement pause
stages.what: Training pauses while two measurements run: which lesson pushes the vision offset (PULL, NOISE, LEVER) and when body 2's vision stopped answering its face-down views.
notes: 2 of its 3 jobs never ran in an earlier pause, so each counts as 0 (vision_head_pulls, vision_body2_views): this is the earliest it can end

stages.name: Vision repair, if the measurement licenses it
stages.what: If LEVER is met, the vision repair is qualified in its stored-constant form, reviewed, and deployed at its own restart after the memory repair's watch.
notes: not timed: whether a repair is licensed, and its review and watch, depend on the measurement; counted as 0

stages.name: Proprioception token: cause found

notes: found a defect: 5 of 8 bodies' posture token stopped following posture; the repair is built

stages.name: Proprioception repair: review, follow-ups, fixes
stages.what: An independent reviewer checks the repair; meanwhile its author adds a per-body reading of every sense, builds the heading-free input as a second option and checks the other senses per body; then the author fixes what the review finds.

stages.name: Test pause: before-repair baseline, pack, servo under option C, proprioception
stages.what: One training pause for 18 jobs agents left waiting: quick tests; the planner chain's before-repair baseline on checkpoint 415,025; the regression pack's noise; servo strength under option C; the proprioception repair's calibration and measurements (longest, last). It starts when the night pause lifts.
